name: mock-partitioned
description: Offline. Exercises v1 context partitioning (config.proposals.partition): one proposer seat (mock-a) gets a per-seat focus instruction, one (mock-b) is deliberately left out of `slices` and gets no instruction, proving partial partitioning and that an unsliced seat's prompt is unaffected. Mechanism only - no claim this changes proposal quality or diversity.

slices.mock-a: Focus on the config schema and validation surface.
